title: bench env: dev DB default-tenant schema provisioning fails (tenant_schemas.migrations_applied_at NULL) blocks WF-04
summary: The dev/bench DB (`BPM_DB_URL` -> postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5442/bpm_dev) cannot complete default-tenant schema provisioning: `provisionTenantSchema()` for the default tenant (00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000) returns `error.MigrationFailed`, so `public.tenant_schemas.migrations_applied_at` stays NULL. The ISS-0706/GH-791 leg-(d) post-condition added to `src/tools/migrate.zig` then hard-exits `zig build migrate`, which also blocks `zig build bench` (the WF-04 full NFR benchmark procedure). Not VLD-attributable: the branch diff has no migration files and the test DB (5434/bpm_test) migrate passes 147/147. Severity MAJOR — environmental, dev/bench DB only; does not block the VLD-01/02/03 release.
scope: Environment defect on the dev/bench database (BPM_DB_URL, postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5442/bpm_dev). Default-tenant (`tenant_default` for tenant 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000) schema provisioning fails, leaving `public.tenant_schemas.migrations_applied_at` NULL and causing the ISS-0706 leg-(d) post-condition in `src/tools/migrate.zig` to abort `zig build migrate` / `zig build bench`. Affects ONLY the bench path (WF-04 full NFR run). CI / test-DB path unaffected (migrate 147/147 on 5434/bpm_test).
description: During WF03-vld-impl-bugs-20260816 step-6 (RELEASE-VALIDATOR, 2026-08-16T08:17:28Z), the NFR benchmark prerequisite was found to fail against the dev/bench DB. `zig build bench` (WF-04 full NFR metric suite) cannot start: its migrate precondition fails against BPM_DB_URL (postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5442/bpm_dev) with `default tenant schema provisioning failed: error.MigrationFailed (tenant_id=00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000)` followed by `post-condition: default tenant_schemas.migrations_applied_at is NULL after provisionTenantSchema() returned -- aborting migrate`. The same failure reproduces with a plain `zig build migrate` against the dev DB. The failure is emitted by the ISS-0706/GH-791 leg-(d) post-condition check in `src/tools/migrate.zig` (the fix that made bench provisioning failures loud instead of silently swallowed). The post-condition firing proves `provisionTenantSchema()` genuinely fails on the dev DB (it returned `error.MigrationFailed` from the `runForSchema` migration pass for the default tenant), which is a distinct, deeper defect from the fresh-DB pre-flight gate that GH-791 fixed. Not VLD-attributable: the WF03-vld-impl-bugs-20260816 branch diff contains no migration files, and `test-env-verify` C3 confirms the test DB (5434/bpm_test) migrate passes 147/147. No NFR_RESULT metrics were emitted, so no NFR threshold failed; the block is on the WF-04 benchmark procedure only.
symptom: zig build bench (and plain zig build migrate) against the dev/bench DB BPM_DB_URL (postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5442/bpm_dev) hard-exits 1 during the default-tenant provisioning step with `default tenant schema provisioning failed: error.MigrationFailed (tenant_id=00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000)` and `post-condition: default tenant_schemas.migrations_applied_at is NULL after provisionTenantSchema() returned -- aborting migrate`. The WF-04 full NFR benchmark cannot start.
investigation_notes: Registered and filed 2026-08-16T09:29:12Z by ISSUE-FIXER (WF03-vld-impl-bugs-20260816 step-08 / step-0.5b). fn:search-issues over docs/issues/ + issue_index.json and `gh issue list` checks: (1) ISS-0706 / GH-791 (GBL-116 bench pre-flight) is the closest prior issue — CLOSED on 2026-08-15T20:03:53Z; its fix added the exact post-condition message observed here (src/tools/migrate.zig leg (d)), so the new finding is the deeper root cause on the existing dev DB that GH-791's post-condition was designed to surface, NOT the fresh-DB pre-flight gate GH-791 fixed. (2) ISS-0604 (RESOLVED) and ISS-0605 (RESOLVED) cover fresh-DB bootstrap circular-dependency and tenant-registry/schema consistency respectively — different root causes, both resolved. (3) `gh issue list --search 'bench in:title'` returns only GH-791 (closed) and GH-732 (NFR-04 benchmark fidelity, unrelated). (4) No GitHub issue references 'ISS-0714'; GitHub issue #714 is an unrelated closed lint issue (different numbering sequence, no collision per prior-run convention). New issue. File-only action per the ORCH task: this issue does NOT implement a fix (future ADHOC/WF-03 run). Evidence sources: handoffs/WF03-vld-impl-bugs-20260816/step-6-release-validator.json (result.issues MAJOR) and docs/status/release-decision-WF03-vld-impl-bugs-20260816.yaml (known_issues).
reproduction: Set BPM_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5442/bpm_dev and run `zig build migrate` (or `zig build bench`): migrate aborts at default-tenant provisioning with `default tenant schema provisioning failed: error.MigrationFailed (tenant_id=00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000)` / `post-condition: default tenant_schemas.migrations_applied_at is NULL after provisionTenantSchema() returned -- aborting migrate`; exit code 1. Contrast: the same migrate against the test DB (postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5434/bpm_test) passes 147/147.
